Team — quick thread to consolidate panel feedback for Alex Mercer (Senior Infra Eng). Interview loop finished yesterday; attached resume for easy reference. Two asks: 1) drop completed scorecards to the Drive link and attach here if possible, 2) flag any critical concerns (security/scale gaps) inline.

Quick anchors for scoring:
- Technical depth (system design, storage/ops): 1-5
- Code + debugging: 1-5
- Cross-team comms: 1-5
- Culture / leadership potential: 1-5
- Confidence (low/med/high) and a 1-sentence rationale

I pushed a blank scorecard into Drive; link below. If we can get at least 3 completed by EOD Friday (6/6) I’ll synthesize and propose next step. If any panelist thinks we need another interview (performance/architecture deep-dive), call it out and suggest what to test.

Attachments: resume_alex_mercer.pdf (pdf)

Kim — filled my scorecard and attached it here (marissa_scorecard_alex_mercer.pdf). Highlights:
- Tech depth: 4 — solid reasoning on leader-follower replication and failure domains; some handwavy parts on GC pauses for the storage layer.
- Code/debug: 4 — clear troubleshooting process, wrote small pseudo-code for the lock-free queue; would like to see a short take-home that exercises edge-case memory pressure.
- Cross-team comms: 3 — good listener, would have liked more clarification questions in the stakeholder scenario.
- Culture/leadership: 4 — strong mentor examples.
- Confidence: high — overall recommend progressing to hiring manager sync or final onsite.

Quick note: flagged a possible misunderstanding about our routing table assumptions (see comment on Q2). If true, that lowers the systems depth to a 3. I put that in the comments section of the PDF.

—Marissa

- Panel numeric median scores (converted to 1-5): Tech depth 4, Code/debug 4, Cross-team 3, Leadership 4.
- Confidence: overall MEDIUM-HIGH.
